name: php-baremetal/conductor
description: Conductor: the php-baremetal Composer plugin -- resolves the package graph, binds the arch (platform) to concrete transports/HALs, and writes baremetal.gen.json. Composer plugin for php-baremetal: reads installed bm-* packages and the project's extra.baremetal, emits baremetal.gen.json for the firmware build (drivers, transports, include dirs, idf-requires, project config).
